name: Nibluma
description: Offline notebooks for handwriting and scanned documents on phones and tablets. Warm paper, blue-black ink and petrol, a serif only where a book speaks.

sans.css: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif
sans.note: Platform face: SF Pro on iOS and iPadOS, Roboto on Android. Controls feel native on each.

mono.note: Bundled with meridian_ui. Rare in Nibluma: sync diagnostics only.

display.css: Literata, "Iowan Old Style", Charter, Georgia, serif
display.note: Literata 500 for the display style only: the library headline, book titles, empty states. Dialog and sheet titles stay in the sans.

reading.css: Literata, "Iowan Old Style", Charter, Georgia, serif

signature: The book as object: covers with a spine and orbital arcs, paper that never inverts, pages resting on the canvas, tools in one floating dock. Petrol marks intent; saved-state green stays status.
